title: Natanael Cano’s New Album Includes Covers by Jeanette & Cristian Castro: See the Tracklist
summary: The corridos tumbados pioneers release Natanael Cano, Vol. 1 soon.
contentText:
Natanael Cano gives his fans a first look at the tracklist for Natanael Cano, Vol. 1 , his upcoming 15-track album set to be released on Aug. 28, Billboard can announce on Thursday (Aug. 20).

The 15-track album — arriving via Rancho Humilde and Los CT Records, distributed by Sony Music US Latin — marks the Mexican singer’s return to his pioneering corridos tumbados after his reggaetón/hip-hop-leaning Porque La Demora (2025).

While Cano has already released three singles — “Aprevenido,” “Pa La Maña” featuring Gabito Ballesteros and Adriel Favela and “La Cherokee” with Ballesteros — he also reveals a few beloved covers, including “Frente a Frente” (by Spanish singer-songwriter Jeanette) and “Por Amarte Así” (by Mexican popstar Cristian Castro).

The new release also follows his collaboration, “Three Nations,” featured on the Official FIFA World Cup 2026 Album alongside 21 Savage and French Montana, which dropped in June. Additionally, the Hermosillo, Sonora artist is gearing up for a stadium tour across Mexico, kicking off with two sold-out shows at Mexico City’s Estadio GNP on Sept. 18 and 19.

On the Billboard charts, Cano has placed four songs on the Billboard Hot 100 : “PRC” with Peso Pluma (No. 33), “AMG” (No. 37) and “Vino Tinto” (No. 68) with Gabito Ballesteros and Peso Pluma, as well as “Ch y La Pizza” (No. 91) with Fuerza Regida, among other notable chart achievements.
